name: Sheel Mohnot
description: Sheel is a co-founder of Better Tomorrow, a seed-stage venture capital fund investing in Fintech companies globally. His own startup experience includes 2 successful FinTech exits – a payments company and a high-stakes auction company, and he is GP of the 500 Fintech fund. He formerly worked as a financial services consultant at BCG and started his FinTech career at the non-profit p2p lender Kiva.

investment_theses.quote: I always start with a lens of: is this building a better world?
What I'm looking for is somebody who can clearly articulate and define their vision — why they're going to win. That's how you raise money, convince future employees. When I see that, I get excited.
At the stage that I invest, the entrepreneur is what matters most.
